text.aria-label: Subtitle text '13 primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Each model was trained once, on one year of data. Dot: mean difference. Line: interval from resampling whole calendar months (95%). Each pair compares the two weather products. Above zero: the older training year is worse.'
text.tspan: 13 primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026.
Each model was trained once, on one year of data.
Dot: mean difference. Line: interval from resampling whole calendar months
(95%). Each pair compares the two weather products.
Above zero: the older training year is worse.
